output_root_rationale: matches the existing per-topic report convention (error_taxonomy/, feature_importance/, frequency/, morphology/), each with _control/ tables/ figures/ validation/

tasks.question: At each exact phoneme length, what fraction of whole words does each route get wrong, for trained real words versus novel pseudowords?
tasks.metric: word_error (primary y-axis); raw_edit_distance carried in TSV as post-failure severity only
tasks.grain: seed x route x lexicality x exact_length; plus across-seed summary
tasks.exclusions: rows outside in_LICHTHEIM_CLEAN; length 6 absent by construction and never imputed
tasks.uncertainty_display: all four seeds visible as points; across-seed mean line; cell_mean_bootstrap 95% band; item count printed per lexicality x length bin; no smoothing; slope is not the central result
tasks.estimability: report every cell with n >= 1; floor cells are never dropped; a zero word-error rate is a result

tasks.question: Among the 800 WFE source-real items, which are wrong and what do those errors look like?
tasks.population: all 800 source_lexicality == real items in FAITHFUL_WFE_ALL, 4 seeds x 3 routes = 9600 rows
tasks.metric: exhaustive item-level listing of every word_error == 1 event with literal existing columns
tasks.grain: erroneous seed x route x item event
tasks.joins: none; EOS class derived with frozen eos_diagnostics.classify_eos
tasks.uncertainty_display: descriptive only; both unique erroneous item counts and seed x item error-event counts reported wherever a proportion appears
tasks.estimability: descriptive; no confirmatory model fitted in this pass; length and frequency association reported as observed rates, not adjusted for the exposure confound

tasks.question: Which novel pseudowords does the LTM-only route reproduce exactly, and how do the success groups differ on already-validated fields?
tasks.population: 391 NOVEL_PSEUDOWORD items, LTM route only, 4 seeds
tasks.metric: per-item count of seeds with exact_match == 1 -> ALWAYS_SUCCESSFUL (4/4), MIXED_SUCCESS (1-3/4), ALWAYS_FAILED (0/4)
tasks.grain: item (all four seed outcomes preserved), then group
tasks.gate_confidence_rule: gate = sigmoid(2.0 * (lexical_confidence - 0.7)) is a deterministic monotone function of confidence; the two are reported as one variable, never as independent evidence
tasks.proxy_rule: no proxy invented, no new feature computed
tasks.estimability: descriptive group comparison with n; no significance test introduced

tasks.question: Does the faithful serial-position error profile differ across FULL, WM and LTM?
tasks.population: FAITHFUL_WFE_ALL with faithful real/pseudo source labels retained (800/400)
tasks.metric: zip-mismatch positional error rate per item x seed

estimand.alignment: zip with the prediction re-padded to the target length; NOT Levenshtein
estimand.numerator: count of item x seed rows mismatching at that 1-based position
estimand.denominator: item x seed rows in that (lexicality, length) cell
estimand.after_eos: trimmed predictions are re-padded to <PAD>, so post-EOS positions count as mismatches (recovers Dager blanking)
estimand.interpolation: PCHIP to 100 points, item-count weighted across lengths; shown only alongside empirical points

tasks.grain: route x lexicality x length x position
tasks.uncertainty_display: empirical values plotted as points and thin lines; no unjustified smooth curve
tasks.estimability: reproduction gate: applying the frozen function to faithful/full must reproduce faithful_figure2C_table.tsv before any extension is written
tasks.non_overwrite: existing faithful Figure 2C files are read-only; new files use the yc4_ prefix

tasks.question: Can route-specific feature importance be estimated, and for which routes?
tasks.population: LICHTHEIM_CLEAN, per route, as fitted by the existing validated A15 run
tasks.method: audit of existing validated outputs; NOT a refit

existing_protocol.split_unit: item (all three route rows of an item stay together)
existing_protocol.permutation_semantics: permutation acts on raw factors, rewriting every derived column; dummies and interaction terms are never permuted independently
existing_protocol.route_handling: one model per route in the route_specific family

tasks.added_quantity: outcome density per route x population (share of non-zero outcomes, train and test)
tasks.rule: estimable only where the existing validated run recorded model_status == OK; otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE_CEILING_OR_SPARSE_OUTCOME with the original status preserved
tasks.zero_importance_rule: a non-estimable cell is NEVER assigned zero importance
tasks.negative_r2_rule: negative test R2 is preserved as recorded, never clipped

global_rules: frozen predictions only; no torch, no checkpoint, no inference
no scientific value hardcoded; counts asserted at run time (671/391/1062, 800/400, 14400, 4 seeds, 3 routes, lengths [3,4,5,7,8,9])
faithful and clean populations never pooled in one estimate
reuse io.load_canonical / io.clean_subset / io.write_table / plotting.save_figure / common constants
red = real, blue = pseudo reserved; exposure categories use the neutral grey palette
prior release outputs verified byte-unchanged at the end of the pass
nothing staged, committed, pushed, or promoted into the final release
